verdict.rationale: Airweave syncs and stores copies of user data (community notes it copies data), so on-demand deletion for privacy is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never documents deleting a single item, deleting per entity or source connection, or full erasure. The vague Pipedream mention of 'manage your collections' does not establish a documented deletion or erasure capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can delete a user's memories on demand — single memory, per-entity, or full erasure — to satisfy privacy requirements
